scientific_integrity: Analytical proofs with reproducible finite tests. No independent audit or historical priority certification has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: The inversion recovers only the unlabeled planar directional-width distribution, not the base or its area. Invariant affine-plane sampling is essential. The closest 1992 cylinder stereology article and a 1971 paper on isotropic random lines through generalized cylinders were only accessible at metadata/abstract level; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Cap-contact stereology of convex cylinders: an exact law and width-distribution recovery
